# Results

This directory contains evaluation metrics and visualizations generated by `notebooks/03-baseline-model.ipynb` for the **AI Music Origin Classification** project.

## 1. Generated Files

| File | Written by | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `baseline_comparison.csv` | `03-baseline-model.ipynb` | Validation metrics for six baseline classifiers |
| `baseline_test_metrics.json` | `03-baseline-model.ipynb` | Final test metrics for the best model selected by validation Macro F1 |
| `figures/baseline_model_comparison.png` | `03-baseline-model.ipynb` | Validation Macro F1 comparison across all six classifiers |
| `figures/logistic_regression_confusion_matrix.png` | `03-baseline-model.ipynb` | Validation confusion matrix for CLAP Logistic Regression |
| `figures/svm_confusion_matrix.png` | `03-baseline-model.ipynb` | Validation confusion matrix for CLAP SVM |
| `figures/k-nn_confusion_matrix.png` | `03-baseline-model.ipynb` | Validation confusion matrix for CLAP k-NN |
| `figures/baseline_test_confusion_matrix.png` | `03-baseline-model.ipynb` | Test confusion matrix for the selected best model |

## 2. Baseline Model Comparison

Six baseline classifiers were evaluated using two feature representations: **CLAP embeddings** and **handcrafted acoustic features**.

| Features | Model | Validation Macro F1 |
|---|---|---:|
| CLAP | Logistic Regression | 0.8713 |
| CLAP | SVM | 0.8685 |
| Handcrafted | SVM | 0.8209 |
| CLAP | k-NN | 0.7921 |
| Handcrafted | Logistic Regression | 0.7657 |
| Handcrafted | k-NN | 0.7183 |

A majority-class DummyClassifier was also evaluated, achieving a Macro F1 of **0.0667**.

**Logistic Regression with CLAP embeddings** achieved the highest validation Macro F1 and was selected for final test evaluation.

## 3. Final Test Results

| Metric | Value |
|---|---:|
| Accuracy | 0.8378 |
| Balanced Accuracy | 0.8378 |
| Macro Precision | 0.8380 |
| Macro Recall | 0.8378 |
| Macro F1 | 0.8378 |

## 4. Generalization Analysis

| Dataset | Macro F1 |
|---|---:|
| Train | 0.9943 |
| Validation | 0.8713 |
| Test | 0.8378 |

The train-validation gap of **0.1229** suggests possible overfitting. The validation-test gap of **0.0335** indicates a smaller decrease in performance on unseen data.
